objective: Same-selected-v1-winner terrain-only extension, chosen after seeing the small study. Never a joint-method confirmation.
main: Fixed existing terrain(x) and bottom(box,x,ground,split) with original parameters and two disjoint return halves. Alter only z and height to change the bottom, preserving top and selected anchor.
wrong_control: For the offline negative control only, rotate fractional bottom adjustments among edited rows of the same source, target and recording ordered by a hash of the input ordinal. Use a nonzero half-rotation when at least two eligible rows exist, preserve eligibility and the multiset of relative edits. Report one-row strata and same-physical-frame assignments. No task label is used in the permutation. Main is one frame.
data: 18,620 historically exposed ordinary directions (9,310 expressions). Reconstruct all source winners from sealed native predictions. Reuse exact sampling seed and transform native model coordinates, same frozen v1. Compare all six directions, full denominator, recording resampling, all threshold crosses. No target-label selection.
certificate: If raw winner misses and new box passes .50 while all A256 miss, test both undirected-zero and registered PCA yaw for all 256 plus pre/post unique-IoU and seed/point-ownership where available. This extension does not run the extra role or vocabulary prompts. Report as beyond A256 only. Full panel identity metric when no independent reference annotation is overlap/point-based, not human judgement.
